title: Find All Substring Positions
question: Print every starting index where a substring occurs, including overlaps.
code:
text = input()
part = input()
if not part:
    print([])
else:
    positions = [i for i in range(len(text) - len(part) + 1) if text.startswith(part, i)]
    print(positions)
explanation: Checking each index includes overlapping matches.
